info.name: Kigali Clinic JPA and JPQL Quiz
info.description: Requests for A1-C4 and both bonus requirements. Update collection variables to match the records in your local database. The two bulk-operation requests modify or delete database rows.

item.name: A1 - Patients by last name
item.description: Derived query: IgnoreCase matches the last name and OrderBy sorts first names ascending.

item.name: A2 - Appointments by status
item.description: Derived query: accepts the AppointmentStatus enum and orders appointment dates ascending.

item.name: A3 - Appointments between dates
item.description: Derived Between query: LocalDate start and end are parsed by the controller; both bounds are inclusive and results are ordered by date.

item.name: A4 - Save appointment and check double booking
item.description: Derived exists check: a non-cancelled appointment for the same doctor and date returns HTTP 409. Use an existing doctor/date pair to demonstrate the conflict.

item.name: B1 - Doctors by specialization
item.description: JPQL joins Doctor.specializations and compares specialization names with LOWER, so matching is case-insensitive.

item.name: B2 - Doctors without an office
item.description: JPQL checks Doctor.office IS NULL and sorts doctors by last name ascending.

item.name: B3 - Unused specializations
item.description: JPQL checks whether the doctors collection IS EMPTY; it does not count doctors.

item.name: B4 - Patients of a doctor
item.description: JPQL selects DISTINCT patients through Appointment.doctor. A missing doctor ID should return HTTP 404 with the specified message.

item.name: C1 - Appointment counts by status
item.description: JPQL groups appointments by status and returns each status with its count; statuses with no appointments do not appear.

item.name: C2 - Frequent patients
item.description: JPQL groups by Patient, filters groups with HAVING COUNT at least min, and orders highest counts first.

item.name: C3 - Busiest office
item.description: JPQL joins Appointment to Doctor to Office, groups and orders by appointment count descending, and returns only the top row. With no matches, expect No appointments yet.

item.name: C4 - Cancel a doctor's appointments for a date
item.description: One JPQL bulk UPDATE cancels that doctor's appointments on the date except COMPLETED ones. This request changes database data.

item.name: Bonus - Appointments page
item.description: Returns Page metadata including totalPages and totalElements. The controller builds Pageable from page, size, and sort.

item.name: Bonus - Delete cancelled appointments before date
item.description: One JPQL bulk DELETE removes cancelled appointments before the cutoff date. This request permanently deletes database rows.
